edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - E Equinox is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Unbreakable (E) is 16s early, 8s at rank 5 — the shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles, wait it out. - Winter's Bite (Q) is 8s early, 6s at rank 5. - Glacial Fissure (R) is 130/115/100s, a fight call, not a habit.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies. Bad trade: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: Good trade: bait Unbreakable's shield out with a throwaway Starcall poke before committing your real burst window. Bad trade: refilling mid-fight at half HP — his passive stun finishes what Winter's Bite starts.
